_comment: Per-flat manual corrections, keyed by flat number. "allocate" moves Tally receipts that carry no flat number (e.g. Capital Ac) onto a flat, keyed by Vch No. "renumber" maps old flat numbers to new ones (Tally receipts and agreements), e.g. {"403": "503"}. "buildings" gives each building its English name and the spellings it has in Index-II text / Tally book titles; "books" names the building of a Tally book that does not say it in its title, e.g. {"idfc 5112.xlsx": "Maitri Heights"} (matched on the file name).
